description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates three evaluation metrics (precision, recall, and F1-score) across five model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” and uses a categorical (nominal) scale with the categories, from left to right: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 56 to 66, with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 percentage points (58, 60, 62, 64, 66). Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: the purple precision line is at 65.45 for “Full model (Ours),” drops to 61.06 at “w/o Prompt,” rises to 62.22 at “w/o Augmentation,” then increases to 64.06 at “w/o Attention” and 65.44 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; the blue recall line is at 65.78 for “Full model (Ours),” decreases to 59.64 at “w/o Prompt,” increases to 63.75 at “w/o Augmentation,” then declines to 59.17 at “w/o Attention” and 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; the brown F1-score line is at 65.16 for “Full model (Ours),” decreases to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt,” increases to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation,” then decreases to 59.67 at “w/o Attention” and 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” A legend in the lower-left maps colors to the three metrics.
caption_used: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants', labeled as nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 65.45% with the 'Full model (Ours)' and shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for 'Ours', drops sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' and continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation.' The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.
